settings.time_unit: mean pass duration of the chunk size, from the first study
settings.arrivals: generated in real time, not from any person
settings.start_delay: from just before the request call to the first line of the calculation, any wait behind an earlier pass included
settings.pass_time: from the first line of the calculation to the return of its last synchronize
settings.desktop_load: a working desktop. Utilization, memory and core clock are read before and after every block as utilization.gpu,memory.used,clocks.sm

note: One card, one machine, one model, generated arrivals. Nothing here is a latency bound or a measure of human performance.
